name: R080-spark-whiscash-future-sight-milotic
why: Challenge 4 (luck4 rebuild). The old lead Whiscash alone almost never paralyses Milotic: its AI picks Future Sight, Earthquake, Earthquake, Future Sight (Spark only at turn 4, when Milotic is nearly dead, 0 of 20 seeds paralysed). Now the opponent's lead is Ampharos (518, Thunder Wave): it uses Thunder Wave on turn 0 and the player's Milotic (559, Marvel Scale) is paralysed on turn 1 in 10 of 10 seeds. Milotic's Ice Beam knocks Ampharos out; the next opponent Whiscash (483, Future Sight) uses Future Sight on its first turn, so the stored damage is computed against a paralysed Marvel Scale Milotic (calculateFutureAttackBaseDamage).
